a.description: array to be inverted. Must have ``prod(a.shape[:ind]) == prod(a.shape[ind:])``
constraints: a must have a shape that can be split into two parts of equal product
input array 'a' and output array must have compatible shapes

ind.description: positive integer specifying the number of indices in the tensor product.
constraints: ind must be a positive integer

output.description: array of shape ``(*a.shape[ind:], *a.shape[:ind])`` containing the tensor inverse of ``a``.
